COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
CRLR No. 189 of 2014
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Shri Bhagwat Mehra, learned counsel for the 
revisionist.
2. Shri B.P.S. Mer, learned Brief Holder for the 
State / respondent no. 1.
3. All the connected revisions are filed against 
the common judgment dated 15.05.2014 passed by 
Addl. Sessions Judge, Almora in Criminal Appeal 
No. 44 of 2013 (Ram Singh and others Vs. State of 
Uttarakhand), therefore, all the revisions shall be 
heard together. 
4. Steps were taken by the learned counsel for 
the revisionist for effecting service upon 
respondents no. 2 to 4, however, the office report 
indicates that notice could not be served upon 
them. 
5. Learned counsel for the revisionist submits 
that he will take fresh steps for effecting service 
upon respondent nos. 2 to 4 within a week. 
6. Let notices be served upon respondents no. 2 
to 4 through Chief Judicial Magistrate concerned. 
7. List this case along with other connected 
revisions on 30.06.2023.
8. Learned counsel for the revisionist 
undertakes that he will file the translated copy of 
the judgment under challenge in the meantime. 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 24.05.2023
SKS

4. As prayed by learned counsel for the

no. 2 to 4. 
5. List after service report.
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)

Hon'ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J. 
1. Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, learned counsel appears for 
the revisionist, Mr. B.P.S. Mer, learned Brief Holder for 
the State appears for respondent No. 1 and Mr. R.P. 
Nautiyal, learned Senior Counsel assisted by Mr. Pawan
